items.title: Perak housewife wins Toto 4D Jackpot TWICE in 3 years — RM14.3 million total
items.detail: After losing their jobs in the MCO, she and her husband bought Lucky Pick tickets for 3 years. 2023: RM1.4m. 1 Aug 2026 (Draw 6165/26): numbers 5900 + 6900 → RM12,946,225.55. Verified true by The Star QuickCheck.

items.title: A recurring dream of '5785' won a woman RM16.3 million in Magnum 4D Jackpot
items.detail: A 54-year-old business owner kept seeing 5785 in her sleep, bought a System Bet-8 — then watched draw numbers 3887 and 5785 both appear. 'I got my son to scan the ticket with the MyMagnum app just to be sure.'

items.title: Penang businessman won RM18.2m Magnum jackpot playing family car plate numbers
items.detail: Years of the same numbers + System Play-4 at his lucky Taman Desaria outlet. 'It finally paid off.' Prove the car-plate-numbers religion.

items.title: 72-year-old Penang housewife hit RM40.12m Supreme Toto 6/58 on a RM420 Lucky Pick
items.detail: February 2026. In the same season, a Singaporean housewife took RM24.3 million from a RM4 bet in the same game. Lucky Pick season was real.

items.title: Johor businessman banked RM12.73m with numbers his daughter picked during a board game
items.detail: Kids > algorithms. A board game, a daughter's fingers, RM12.73 million. (Reported in the great 2026 Lucky Pick season roundup.)
